dataList.name: Role Model
dataList.desc:
If there are 2 or more "Fixer" Identities in the Team Loadout, activate the following effect for 1 "Fixer" ally with the lattermost Deployment Order (excluding Backup units):
- Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, gain [Emulation]

Turn Start: Allied "Fixer" Identities heal 2 SP for every 2 allied "Fixer" Identities on the field

If there are 3 or more "Fixer" Identities of the same faction on the field, activate the following effect:
- Base Attack Skills of allies that have [Emulation] deal +(# of "Fixer" allies on the field x 3)% damage (max 15%)

If there are 3 or more "Fixer" Identities of different factions on the field, activate the following effect:
- On Base Attack Skill Use by an ally that has [Emulation], the said ally gains 1 [Enhancement] (2 times per turn)
- On Hit using a Base Attack Skill by an ally that has [Emulation], inflict 1 [Vulnerable] (2 times per turn; in Focused Encounters, the Part)

dataList.name: Carefully-selected Medicinal Herbs
dataList.desc:
Attack Skills additionally triggered by Skills that have the [ComboSkill] effect or triggered by allies' Skill / Passive effects deal +10% damage
- Deal an additional +2% damage every time the above effect activates (max 10%)
- For Skills that have the [ComboSkill] effect, gain 1 [AttackDmgUp] every time the said Skills are used (max 2 per Identity)
- If the ally is a "<noparse>Dawn Office</noparse>" or "<noparse>Wedge Office</noparse>" Identity, the said ally gains 1 [Enhancement] (max 2 per Identity)

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: <noparse>Deal more damage</noparse>, gain [AttackDmgUp]. Gain [Enhancement] upon fulfilling conditions

Pride of the Knight
dataList.desc:

dataList.name: Sword Laced with Grief
dataList.desc:
Pierce Base Skills that inflict [Sinking] Potency, Count, or Unique [Sinking] gain Final Power +1

On Hit by an ally using a Skill, if target has -20 or lower SP, deal Gloom damage equal to [Sinking] Potency to target (once per Skill)
- If the said Skill was a Pierce Skill, deal additional fixed damage equal to ([Sinking] Count on target / 2) (once per Skill)

[Lobotomy E.G.O::<noparse>The Sword Sharpened with Tears</noparse> Rodion Exclusive Effect]
On Hit against an enemy using the final Coin of a Base Skill that consumes [Charge] and has 1 Atk Weight, deal Pride damage to all enemies equal to ([Charge] Potency consumed)% of final damage (including Unique [Charge])

[<noparse>The Sword Sharpened with Tears</noparse> Hong Lu E.G.O Skill Exclusive Effect]
E.G.O Skill Final Power +1

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: Skills gain Final Power, deal Gloom damage; if target has low SP, deal fixed damage

dataList.name: White Cravat
dataList.desc:
Turn Start: Activates when there are 3 or more "<noparse>Wedge Office</noparse>" Identities (counts Backup Identities)

[<noparse>Wedge Office</noparse> Rep Outis Exclusive Effect]
- Turn Start: If the condition above was met for the first time, gain 20 [ComboWedge]
- Upon using "Assume Wedge Formation", "... All units, engage for collision.", "The Wedge in the Wake of Dawnbreak", gain 1 [ComboWedgeDawn] next turn (2 times per turn)
- If "Assume Wedge Formation" was used, regain half of the consumed [ComboWedge] at the next Turn Start (once per turn, rounded down)

dataList.name: Black Tricorne
dataList.desc:
In a Clash, inflict 2 [Vibration] on the enemy for every Clash (3 times per Skill)

On Crit by an ally using a Basic Attack Skill against enemies, if the main target has [Vibration], trigger [VibrationExplosion]; then, reduce target's [Vibration] Count by 1 (once per Skill)
- If the enemy is in [Switch_Vibration] state, deal +10% damage on Critical Hit
- If the enemy is in [VibrationNesting] state, deal an additional +5% damage on Critical Hit for each type of <noparse>superposed</noparse> Unique [Vibration] (max 25%)

simpleDesc.simpleDesc:
In a Clash, inflict Tremor
Trigger Tremor Burst when conditions are met, Skills deal more damage on Critical Hit

dataList.name: Backup Body Adaptation Device
dataList.desc: When triggering [VibrationExplosion] on enemies that have [VibrationCollapse], deal Sloth damage to each target equal to (each target's Defense Level reduction)% of the damage dealt (max 15%)

dataList.name: Broken Spearhead
dataList.desc: On Crit using a Pierce Base Attack Skill, inflict [EmbeddedSpearhead] on target at Attack End (once per turn per Identity; in Focused Encounters, the Parts)
